long_biography.plain_text:
Hospitality shaped Kastelein's commercial life from an early stage. In his thirties he ran hotel interests and developed Rotterdam premises for upmarket dining and café businesses. He has also said that he once owned restaurants. Together, these activities explain the fortune attributed to his operating years.

After withdrawing from the sector, Kastelein became a far less visible businessman. A continuing corporate platform has not emerged around his name, nor has a well-defined investment office or board portfolio. That absence makes his old hotel and venue-development work the last clear account of his career. Whether he retained interests from those ventures or redirected his capital elsewhere is not known.
